Who We Are
 We don’t just develop embedded software — we engineer intelligence into products. The Embedded Competence Center at NTT DATA Romania brings together experts in embedded systems, firmware development, and hardware–software integration, delivering robust and high-performance solutions for complex, safety-critical environments. With strong expertise in C/C++, AUTOSAR, real-time operating systems, and communication protocols, we design scalable embedded architectures, integrate software seamlessly with hardware, and ensure compliance with industry standards. Across the industries we support — from Automotive and Industrial Automation to Smart Devices and IoT — we transform reliable embedded technology into a foundation for innovative, dependable products.
We are looking for an experienced Test Engineer to join an automotive project focused on Radar / ADAS systems. The role involves defining, developing and executing system-level tests based on customer and system requirements, analyzing test results and supporting the investigation of detected issues. The engineer will work closely with System Engineering, Software Development and Integration teams in an international automotive environment.
 What You'll Be Doing
Analyze and clarify requirements and derive appropriate test cases.
Create and maintain test specifications, test cases and test procedures.
Perform functional, integration, diagnostic, robustness and regression testing.
Execute tests on test benches, HIL environments and/or vehicles.
Analyze system behavior and validate interfaces between the radar sensor and other ECUs.
Perform testing of automotive communication interfaces such as:
CAN / CAN FD
Automotive Ethernet
Perform diagnostic testing using UDS and analyze DTC behavior.
Analyze CAN traces, logs and measurement data.
Investigate failed test cases and support root-cause analysis.
Report defects and collaborate with development teams during debugging and issue resolution.
Prepare test reports and document test results.
Support system integration and validation activities.
Contribute to test automation and continuous improvement of the testing process.
Validate radar sensor functionality and system behavior.
Analyze radar outputs and detected object information.
Validate parameters such as:
detection range
object position
relative velocity
range accuracy
angle accuracy
object detection and tracking
Perform tests under different environmental and driving conditions.
Support radar sensor integration, alignment and calibration activities.
Support bench and vehicle-level validation.
 What You'll Bring Along
Degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Automotive Engineering, Mechatronics or similar.
Experience in SW Testing, System Testing, System Integration Testing or Automotive Testing.
Good understanding of test methodologies and test design techniques.
Experience in deriving test cases from system requirements.
Good knowledge of automotive communication protocols, especially:
CAN / CAN FD
Experience with Vector CANoe / CANalyzer.
Knowledge of automotive diagnostics:
UDS
DTC
Basic understanding of embedded systems and ECUs.
Experience with measurement and debugging tools.
Good analytical and troubleshooting skills.
Good English communication skills.
 Nice to Have
Previous experience with Radar or ADAS systems.
Experience with Vector VT System.
Knowledge of CAPL.
Experience with HIL / SIL testing.
Knowledge of Automotive Ethernet.
Experience with tools such as:
DOORS / DOORS NG
PTC / MKS
Knowledge of ASPICE processes.
Basic understanding of ISO 26262 Functional Safety.
Experience with vehicle testing.
ISTQB certification.
